description: Sets a thread's state inside the Customermates inbox only, not at the email or chat provider. Requires threadId and state. state is one of unread, open, closed, or spam; the state shows as a badge on the thread and is filterable in the inbox, and it does not hide or delete anything. Setting the state a thread already has is a harmless no-op. The provider mailbox, the messages themselves, and any linked CRM records are left untouched.

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.
